protocol: Paired replay: same engine, windows and default body orientation; only initial velocity changes. Velocity is least-squares slope of preceding 0.20 s, no future samples. Direction comparison requires both speeds >0.2 m/s. Stage shifts are consecutive destination distances, NOT causal attribution.
limitations: Reused short windows, not independent validation
Default body orientation and approximate roles remain
Past velocity is an estimate; no physical or tactical truth labels
Stage shifts can include canceled or cached intentions; magnitude does not prove error
No calibration, behavior change or learning
